en: A monochrome/sepia postcard view of a town situated along a river. There are several prominent smokestacks or chimneys indicating an industrial area, with a bridge crossing the river. The surrounding landscape is hilly, dotted with trees and buildings, including a church with a steeple. In the foreground, some people are visible in an open field. The name 'LUNZENAU a.d.M.' is printed in the lower right corner.
